description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three sentiment analysis tools, TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT, on two categories of tweets: Emoji Tweets and Overall Tweets. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, labeled "Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis", with the two categories listed in order. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Each category has three bars, representing the accuracy of TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT, which are distinguished by different fill patterns and colors as indicated in the legend. For Emoji Tweets, TEXTBLOB has an accuracy of approximately 0.37, VADER has an accuracy of around 0.51, and ChatGPT has an accuracy of about 0.66. For Overall Tweets, TEXTBLOB has an accuracy of approximately 0.37, VADER has an accuracy of around 0.50, and ChatGPT has an accuracy of about 0.66. The bars are grouped by category, with the three tools represented side by side for each category. The bars are not sorted in a specific order within each category, and no bars are visually emphasized.
